claimed_coverage: Tests that all 7 TensorFlow layer classes in perslay.py (GridPerslayWeight, GaussianMixturePerslayWeight, PowerPerslayWeight, GaussianPerslayPhi, TentPerslayPhi, FlatPerslayPhi, Perslay) can be instantiated without errors by verifying the deprecated dynamic=True argument has been removed from super().__init__() calls.
fix_patch_grounding: The fix.patch removes dynamic=True from 10 super().__init__() calls across 4 files: cubical_layer.py (1), lower_star_simplex_tree_layer.py (1), perslay.py (7 occurrences for 7 layer classes), and rips_layer.py (1). The tests target the 7 layer classes in perslay.py which are pure Python and can be tested without building the C++ gudhi package.
issue_context_used: The issue describes that TensorFlow layers use deprecated dynamic=True argument in super().__init__() which causes instantiation errors in recent TensorFlow releases. The tests verify that layers can be instantiated without this deprecated argument.
notes: The tests load perslay.py directly using importlib to avoid package __init__.py dependencies on C++ modules (cubical_complex, rips_complex, simplex_tree) that require CMake build. The tests verify instantiation of all 7 layer classes in perslay.py, which covers 7 out of 10 occurrences of the fix. The remaining 3 occurrences (CubicalLayer, LowerStarSimplexTreeLayer, RipsLayer) require the full gudhi C++ package to be built, which is not possible without network access for git submodules. Tests: 9 total (8 instantiation tests + 1 behavior test). All 9 pass on fixed code, all 9 fail on buggy code.
